name: dsh-update-hub
author: Yonan
description: 批量更新 DSH 插件：左侧栏常驻图标显示待更新数量，点开是列表、进度与单条/全部更新。走 pnpm 安装侧、不经过桌面端的「移除在跑的插件」校验，所以在用的插件也能装上；支持启动时检测、定时检测与空闲自动更新。｜Batch-update DSH plugins from a permanent sidebar icon with a pending-count badge: list, real progress, per-plugin or all-at-once install. Uses the pnpm install path rather than the desktop host's remove-bundle route, so plugins that are currently running can still be updated. Optional checks at boot, on a timer, and unattended auto-update while idle.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && npm pack --dry-run
